finalText:
**The build passes now.**

One real error was hiding in the noise: `src/core/settings.js` used a bare `retries`, which nothing had defined. That threw `ReferenceError: retries is not defined` and killed the link step.

I changed it to read `env.retries`, with a new `DEFAULT_RETRIES = 2` as the fallback.

Build exits 0 and emits `dist/bundle.js`.

The three warnings are still there, untouched, since none of them broke anything:

| Code | Where |
| --- | --- |
| W1042 deprecated `crypto.createCipher` | `src/legacy/adapter.js` |
| W2213 unused export `formatLegacyDate` | `src/utils/format.js` |
| W3307 circular import | `src/core/graph.js` ↔ `src/state/tracker.js` |

Happy to clear those next if you want.
